title: Trace and Lie solvability under extension of fields
statement:
Let $k\to E$ be a field extension [def-weil-field]. Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional $k$-vector space [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace], and let $f:V\to V$ be $k$-linear. Write $f_E=1\otimes f$ on $V_E=E\otimes_k V$. Then
$$\operatorname{tr}_{E}(f_E)=\iota(\operatorname{tr}_{k}(f)),$$
where $\iota:k\to E$ is the given field homomorphism. Let $\mathfrak g$ be a finite-dimensional $k$-Lie algebra [def-wf-lie-algebra], with derived series $D^0\mathfrak g=\mathfrak g$, $D^{n+1}\mathfrak g=[D^n\mathfrak g,D^n\mathfrak g]$. Give $\mathfrak g_E=E\otimes_k\mathfrak g$ the bracket $[a\otimes x,b\otimes y]=ab\otimes[x,y]$. For every $n\geq0$,
$$D^n(\mathfrak g_E)=(D^n\mathfrak g)_E,$$
where the right side is the image of $E\otimes_kD^n\mathfrak g\to E\otimes_k\mathfrak g$. Moreover, $\mathfrak g_E$ is solvable if and only if $\mathfrak g$ is solvable.
